description: Save a durable request for staff. stored=true confirms local persistence, not staff contact or successful transfer. Immediately invoke transfer_to_number separately for live transfer; do not delay caller-requested transfer with extra questions.

request_body_schema.description: Persist available staff-request context. Reuse request_id and identical body for technical retries. The tool does not transfer the call.

mode.description: live_transfer pro okamzite predani, callback pro pozdejsi zavolani zpet.

caller_phone.description: Telefon volajiciho, pokud je dostupny z call metadata nebo potvrzeny.

request_id.description: Stable unique ID for this staff request within the call, without spaces. Reuse exactly the same ID and identical content for technical retries. Use a new ID only for a new staff request.

conversation_summary.description: Concise available context: original request, preferences, what succeeded and what remains. Do not ask extra questions before caller-requested transfer. Do not include birth number, birth date, IDPAC or verification tokens.

recommended_next_step.description: What staff should do next. Use only known context; do not promise a reservation or a completed transfer.

intent.description: Brief original purpose of the caller request.
